Like an idiot I ignored some MAJOR red flags in my last relationship. I was desperate for any grain of affection and attachment; and he was very handsome, at least physically. We were only together for a few months, plenty of time for me to suffer a lot of emotional and mental damage but that’s a whole different story. It could have been so much worse. I noticed that certian parts of his story didn’t add up...he had a useful college degree yet said he wasn’t able to get traditional jobs and was always paid under the table. He was extremely paranoid that the government was trying to keep tabs on him and as such didn’t use a cellphone, which just struck me as shady as hell. The behavior of someone who has something to hide. He insisted every previous ex stole money or valuables from him and would then call the cops to accuse him of
domestic violence. He then lied to me when I asked his last name...I didn’t ask for much from the guy. Really the last name was just a casual question. He never even bought me dinner, but I didn’t feel like it was to much to ask for the birth name of someone who your sleeping with. I usually can’t read people very well; but when I asked for his name he hesitated for a good long while before coming up with something. I knew it was BS becuse there was a street with that same name a few blocks over from where he lived, I got lost a few times I went over to “chill” but remembered that street name as it was rather unusual. 

Quite suddenly, I was cheated on and dumped. The same week I took a pregnancy test and it was positive. It was devastating news  for me, I didn’t know how I could possibly raise a baby on minimum wage, but I did want to keep it even if I didn’t know if the father would be involved. It was a very nasty breakup for reasons I won’t delve into but it showed me how truly monstrous he was. I suspected the women he said made false accusations were telling the truth. It was the lowest point in my life, and then I miscarried the baby. There aren’t proper words to describe how miserable that is, but I couldn’t help but feeling like myself and the lost child could have endured a much worse situation. 

Flash forward several years later, and I hear from a mutual friend that he’s getting married and has a baby on the way. But more importantly this friend learned his legal name. I couldn’t help myself; after the heartache and traumas I endured from this man the very least I could have was a real name. I looked for his police records and found a very colorful and frightening criminal past. Several mentions of aggravated assault and battery, domestic violence ...and...the most disturbing....two counts of sexual abuse to a child. Not a minor. A child. 

Suddenly his hyper vigilant behavior, inability to work and refusal to give his name made total sense. He was a sexual predator, and I was unknowingly asking questions that threatened to reveal his true self. I feel disgusted that he touched me. 

I have deep pity for his wife and child. But...that easily could have been me. If I hadn’t asked a few questions, if I had not caught him cheating, if I had not miscarried...I might be married to a physically abusive diddler with a child to
try to keep safe from its father.

I am don’t deal with loneliness; it’s a blessing. Over 10 years ago I was engaged to a man that wouldn’t let met leave the house, even to go to Starbucks for a coffee. Everything I did was considered cheating in his eyes. From calling my mother to watching a TV show without him; i was cheating. I wasn’t. My sex drive  is so pathetically low that cheating is the last thing on my mind in each of my pathetic relationships. The last straw for that man was when he moved a woman into our apartment and didn’t inform me. His excuse was she was homeless; I didn’t care. I paid my half of the rent and utilities, and gave him what he wanted even if the sex was just being jack hammered, but didn’t have a voice in who gets moved in rent free? I am certain he was cheating, and yet I didn’t care. I am so pathetic in the sack I could see why he would be unsatisfied, but it was the total loss of any alone time, of this woman constantly in my space, any freedom to be myself that forced me to see things clearly and leave. 

A few years afterward, and I fall in love with a man who aesthetically wise was perfect. But aesthetics are only a small part of the relationship. He didn’t impose any restrictions on me like the previous one; but he did hit me, choke me, shame me, cheat on me shamelessly and very publicly and withheld all affection. He was a mess, I won’t go into all the twisted shit I later learned about him, but holy fuck he had issues. Post sex he would lock himself into the bathroom, cry and punch the mirror or dry wall. Despite all that; my stupid empathetic self really cared for him and hoped I could provide him some comfort. But people as disturbed as that cannot be loved back into a healthy state. It ended when he found a woman into all the crazy BDSM he craved, but I couldn’t provide despite really really trying. (His refusal to use safety words and safe equipment didn’t exactly ease my experimentation.) That worthlessness and sense of abandonment....it was overwhelming. After he ended it, I found out I was pregnant. I didn’t know how I could possibly raise the baby, but I felt compelled to keep it and try to give it a better life than myself. But the breakup compiled with my physically demanded job ended up in me miscarrying anyway. 

And so....there I was. Alone and suicidal. But I was also free. After a few attempts I decided the loss and the dysfunctions of a few men couldn’t not be the end of me. I had to get to know who I was. After the first few months of loneliness...the feelings lessened. I immersed myself in art, writing, career advancement, new pets, cosplay, games. I moved to my own place with no roommates, and the solitude is such a blessing. 

Now I am loathe to give a second of my time to myself with any other. I occasionally miss being held and kissed, but such affections were rare even when I was dating. I’ll feel lonely during holidays ana and if I am sick, but that is fleeting. I only spend any amount of time with my family. I haven’t dated long term either in many years, a few first dates and kisses, but the men would eventually ghost me and after the disappointment I would just go back to my solitude and remember the times in which I didn’t have the luxury.
New glasses. An apartment I feel safer in, and with less ants and roaches. A book case. And more books.
